projection: equirectangular, u = lon/360 + 0.5, north at top, direction of (lon, lat) = (cos lat sin lon, sin lat, cos lat cos lon)

color.content: surface albedo only, flat even light, sRGB

height.format: raw little endian uint16, row major, first row at top (north), first column at lon -180, no header
height.meaning: relative height above the MOLA areoid datum, smoothed and repainted to follow the painted features; use for relief and normals, not as survey data

storm.format: 8 bit gray, 255 = full storm cover, soft edge
storm.rotation_seen_from_above: counterclockwise (cyclonic for the north): the arms wind clockwise going outward, measured streak angle -40 to -60 degrees from radial

north_hero_cap.note: the cap seen in the hero image; the hero shows latitudes only up to 63, so it sits here

north_pole_cap.note: second cap at the geographic pole, painted in the far side fill
